method: Actual production WebView2 target renderer/layer-tree BeginFrame/DrawFrame/explicit DroppedFrame IDs. nativeCompactScope: Idle/live geometry uses DirectComposition with no WebView. Its compositor frames cannot be attributed through CDP; native motion unit tests and owned-window smokes cover geometry/ownership, not an unmeasured zero-drop claim.
